candidate.answerReason: For representing the typical wage, the median is more appropriate because an extremely high wage pulls the mean upward while having much less effect on the median.

methods.label: Compare sensitivity to extreme values
methods.explanation: The mean is strongly affected by extreme values, and an extremely large value raises the mean. The median is largely unaffected and better represents the typical level.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 8 comparisons of the mean and median under extreme values.
